gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-devanagar: Powerful and ancient, Nordic keeps a single stroke weight with tight, closed shapes. And Noto Sans Devanagari opens everything back up, its g curling loose below the line, so the two trade weight for breath.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Noto Sans Duployan has a wide, generous mouth on its lowercase a. Nordic, powerful and ancient, stays tightly closed in the heading, so the open body beneath gives each line somewhere to breathe.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-glagoliti: Ancient, forceful lettering, spaced like brush dabs set far apart. Nordic is best at loud, cramped statements, while Noto Sans Glagolitic is best at open, sturdy clarity in its tall lowercase.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic reads easily, its lowercase counters big as drilled glass beads. But Nordic, with strokes like cut wire and closed shapes, grabs the eye first, so give it the larger size.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha keeps its little letters tall, like pen-nib bowls pressed flat. Noto Sans Grantha never snags on a closed-up bowl, so paragraph after paragraph keeps moving forward without a hitch.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Noto Sans Gujarati ends its curves before they turn inward. Nordic does its best work in dowel-like stems and bent arcs, while the body font is best at large, open counters.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-g: Ancient and powerful, Nordic closes its letters tight, each stroke like a stylus held at fixed pressure. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi, with terminals cut back to leave big gaps, reads without strain from start to finish.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Tight, ancient, pressed like a leaf fold: Nordic keeps its round letters upright, with no tilt in the stress. Noto Sans Hanunoo then reads smoothly, its lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Nordic draws every stroke as a thread of ink, with no swelling or tapering anywhere. And Noto Sans Hebrew, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems, keeps lengthy text moving.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-hk: Cramped and ancient, Nordic folds its letters shut like a pressed leaf. And Noto Sans HK, with large lowercase and brush ends lifted before the curve closes, gives that tension room to release.
